title.zh: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
title.en: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈

current_state.zh: Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson hosted a White House lunch with the CEOs of Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to debate the balance between AI innovation and government oversight, with Johnson rejecting a pause on AI development but backing greater transparency and some supervision.
current_state.en: Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson hosted a White House lunch with the CEOs of Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to debate the balance between AI innovation and government oversight, with Johnson rejecting a pause on AI development but backing greater transparency and some supervision.
